description: Currency formatting utility functions for consistent display across the app, including formatting amounts with dynamic precision, USD with credits, and up to six decimal places.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as currency text with optional credits suffix, handling dynamic decimal precision and optional credits display.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText
methods.description: Formats USD amount with credits appended, using default includeCredits=true.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with up to six decimal places and thousands separators.
